description: An @observe function that makes one OpenAI chat call, with session id, user id, metadata, and tags.
notes: lmnr 0.8.8. LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY is capture-project-key. LMNR_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content and the decorator input and output are recorded on the spans. LMNR_RELEASE is capture, and initialize also passes release capture, so the git commit is not read. The default export is gRPC with gzip. force_http sends OTLP HTTP to the receiver origin on its port, path /v1/traces. The HTTP exporter hardcodes gzip, which the receiver rejects, so the scenario forces identity compression on the HTTP trace and log exporters before initialize. disable_batch is true. instruments is only OpenAI. Session, user, metadata, and tags are arguments of @observe. Two spans: answer-weather, type DEFAULT, and openai.chat, type LLM. The observe span has session_id session-1, user_id user-1, metadata.feature weather, and tags as a string array. The child has session, user, and metadata. lmnr.span.path lists both names, and parent_path is empty. Decorator input is a JSON object and the output is a JSON string. Token counts on the child are copied: input 24, output 12, cache_read 8, reasoning 3. ThreadingInstrumentor is always enabled and emitted no spans. There is no separate anonymous-telemetry switch in 0.8.8.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
